Name: Remove Domains from Exchange-Siemplify Inbox Rules
Author: admin
DisplayName: Remove Domains from Exchange-Siemplify Inbox Rules
Description: Action will get as a parameter a list of Domains, and will be able to remove the provided domains from the existing rules. WARNING: Action will modify your current users inbox rules, using EWS. NOTICE - to perform operation, please configure EDiscovery Group and Author permissions. For full details, please visit: https://cloud.google.com/chronicle/docs/soar/marketplace-integrations/exchang. NOTE: Action is running as async, please adjust script timeout value in Siemplify IDE for action as needed.

Parameters.Description: Specify the Domains you would like to remove from the rule, in a comma separated list.

Parameters.DefaultValue: Siemplify - Domains List - Move To Junk
Parameters.Description: Specify the rule to remove the Domains from. If the rule doesn’t exist - action will do nothing.
OptionalValues: Siemplify - Domains List - Move To Junk

Parameters.DisplayName: Remove Domains from all available Rules
Parameters.Description: Specify whether action should look for the provided domains in all of Siemplify inbox rules.

If checked, action will be performed in all mailboxes accessible with current impersonalization settings. If delegated access is used, implicitly specify the mailboxes to search in the "Mailboxes" parameter.

Parameters.DisplayName: How many mailboxes to process in a single batch
Parameters.Description: In case "Perform action in all mailboxes" is checked, action works in batches, this parameter controls how many mailboxes action should process in single batch (single connection to mail server).

AIDescription:
Removes specified domains from existing Microsoft Exchange inbox rules. This action is primarily used to manage and clean up automated mail handling rules (such as blocklists or 'Move to Junk' rules) created within the Exchange environment. It interacts with the Exchange server using EWS (Exchange Web Services) and supports processing across multiple mailboxes.

### Parameters Description

| Parameter | Type | Mandatory | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Domains | String | No | A comma-separated list of domains to be removed from the rule conditions. Note: While marked optional in configuration, the action will fail if no domains are provided. |
| Rule to remove Domains from | String | Yes | The specific rule name to target. Options include 'Siemplify - Domains List - Move To Junk', 'Siemplify - Domains List - Delete', and 'Siemplify - Domains List - Permanently Delete'. |
| Remove Domains from all available Rules | Boolean | No | If enabled, the action will attempt to remove the domains from all three standard Siemplify domain rules, ignoring the specific rule selected in the previous parameter. |
| Perform action in all mailboxes | Boolean | No | If enabled, the action iterates through all mailboxes accessible via the configured impersonation or delegation settings. |
| How many mailboxes to process in a single batch | Integer | No | Defines the number of mailboxes to process in a single execution cycle. This is used for async processing to prevent timeouts. Default is 50. |

### Additional Notes
- **Async Execution:** This action runs asynchronously. If processing a large number of mailboxes, it will yield and resume until all mailboxes are processed.
- **Rule Deletion:** If removing the domains results in a rule having no remaining conditions, the action will delete the rule entirely from the mailbox.
- **Permissions:** Requires EDiscovery Group and Author permissions for the service account.

### Flow Description
1. **Initialization:** The action initializes the Exchange manager and extracts user-provided parameters, including the list of domains and target rules.
2. **Mailbox Discovery:** If 'Perform action in all mailboxes' is selected, it retrieves a list of all searchable mailboxes; otherwise, it targets the primary mailbox.
3. **Rule Retrieval:** For each mailbox in the current batch, the action fetches the existing inbox rules matching the specified names.
4. **Condition Modification:** It parses the 'contains_sender_strings' condition of the rule, identifies the current list of domains, and removes the domains specified in the input.
5. **External Update:** 
    - If domains remain after removal, it sends an EWS `UpdateInboxRules` request to update the rule on the Exchange server.
    - If no domains remain, it sends a `DeleteRuleOperation` to remove the rule.
6. **Batching & Completion:** The action tracks processed mailboxes and either completes the execution or schedules the next batch if more mailboxes remain.
